class Node:
    def __init__(self, val=0, left=None, right=None, random=None):
        self.val = val
        self.left = left
        self.right = right
        self.random = random

def cloneTree(root):
    if not root:
        return None

    # Create a mapping from original nodes to their clones
    node_map = {}

    # First pass: create clones and populate the map
    def create_clones(node):
        if not node:
            return None
        if node in node_map:
            return node_map[node]
        clone = Node(node.val)
        node_map[node] = clone
        clone.left = create_clones(node.left)
        clone.right = create_clones(node.right)
        return clone

    clone_root = create_clones(root)

    # Second pass: set random pointers
    def set_random(node):
        if not node:
            return
        clone = node_map[node]
        clone.random = node_map.get(node.random, None)
        set_random(node.left)
        set_random(node.right)

    set_random(root)
    return clone_root
